properties.description: Established TerraAnalog site. Landforms: layered_sedimentary_outcrop, plains. Top-quartile (rank <= 7 of 28) TerraAnalog profiles: MARS_ASTROBIO_SEDIMENTS, MARS_ROVER_MOBILITY, MOON_ROVER_MOBILITY, MARS_EVA_HABITAT, MARS_ISRU_ICE.
limitations: ERA5 (0.25°) and CHELSA (30 arc-s) are modeled climate fields, not station measurements.
Scores rank relative analog fidelity for one mission objective; not a measure of planetary equivalence.
